```json
  "map": true,
  "subject": {
    "columns": ["protein_id"],
    "resolver": "pharos_protein_gene",

  },
  "object": {
    "columns": ["mondoid", "did"],
    "resolver": "pattern:MONDO|OMIM:^(?:MONDO|MIM):(\\d+)$",
    "category": "biolink:Disease",
    "name_column": "ncats_name"
  },

  "primary_knowledge_source": "infores:uniprot",
  "qualifiers": {},
  "edge_properties": ["did", "evidence", "name"],
  "keep_if": null,
  "split_by": null,
  "by_value": null,
  "notes": "UniProt curators state this gene-disease involvement by hand, so the edge is a knowledge assertion from a manual agent. The object is the MONDO id; when mondoid is empty the MIM accession is used. Most involvements are causal, but some rows are susceptibility entries (e.g. 'autism, susceptibility to'). So biolink:causes would overstate them, and gene_associated_with_condition is used instead. The subject is the protein's gene. The evidence column holds UniProt citation index numbers that only make sense inside the UniProt entry, so it is kept as a property and not as publications."
}
```
